name: Live at Independence Stadium
description: Recorded live in 1985, featuring a massive live version of The Hollow Square.
subtitle: The 1985 Philadelphia Stadium Manifestation
linerNotes: Recorded live on August 15, 1985 before 90,000 fans at Independence Stadium in Philadelphia—the first time Rhys and Claire Manning ever performed on stage as Fractured Prisms.

Enforcing their legendary "Sacred Perimeter" and "Session Ghosts" stage manifesto, the siblings took the stage alone at center field: Claire seated in her manual wheelchair in a single white spotlight with Gwen's wooden flute, flanked by Rhys's towering fortress of analog modular synthesizers, refracting a single beam of stadium light into a sweeping rainbow prism across the Philadelphia night.

studioArchives.title: The "Sacred Perimeter" Stage Architecture
studioArchives.content: To protect Claire's sensory processing in front of 90,000 screaming fans, the stage monitor system was engineered as an acoustic cancellation dome—giving Claire crystal-clear studio isolation at center stage while the stadium PA thundered outward.
